text:
alex: Hi all, first-day snag. I accepted the invite but my account is alex@contractor.redwood.ai and Okta says 'unverified domain' during SSO. No 1Password invite yet and Drive shows 'request access'. Who do I poke?

rita-it: Welcome @alex. Contractors sometimes land on the contractor domain which needs a separate org mapping. I'll validate your domain in Okta and re-send the 1Password invite. Can you confirm your employee ID?

alex: ID 14572. Also I can't enroll passkey; Okta only shows 'Authenticator app' as option.

onboard-bot: Ticket created: ONB-5342 - "Contractor domain mapping + 1P invite for alex". Assigned to rita-it. ETA 4 hours.

hua: @rita-it fyi I saw this earlier with contractor domains — we usually add the contractor alias to the main org and promote the email claim mapping. If you want a quick workaround, add alex@redwood.ai as secondary email on the Okta user and retry SSO.

rita-it: Done: added alex@redwood.ai as a secondary email and resent 1Password. Also enabled temporary Drive access until domain mapping finishes. You should see passkey option after device enroll.

alex: Got 1Password, enrolled a TOTP in the app, and Drive access works. Device enroll popped up and I created a passkey in Chrome; Okta accepted it. All set, thanks!
